_about: Composed glosses (data/composed_form_glosses.json) corrected in context: the rule's gloss of the form is wrong for the ayat it stands in (another sense of the verb, an object that is plainly a thing or a person). Key: root|form|arabic → en, bs, why (the ayah). Same shape as the rule's gloss (clitic words, command, question); checked on every `fil compose build`. Reviewed by AI against the ayah and its translation (2026-11-06); English per Sahih International, Bosnian per Korkut.
